instruction: Identify the target audience for this business.
input: A small clothing brand sells affordable oversized T-shirts aimed at university students.
output: The primary target audience is university students who want comfortable, affordable and casual clothing. Their likely interests include relaxed fashion, versatile outfits and student-friendly prices. The brand should validate these assumptions through customer research.

instruction: Identify the target audience for this business.
input: A local coffee shop sells speciality coffee and fresh pastries near a university campus.
output: The likely target audience includes university students, university staff and people working nearby. They may value convenient locations, quality coffee, a comfortable atmosphere and affordable options. The business should research customer preferences to prioritise these groups.

instruction: Suggest a target audience for this product.
input: A startup sells reusable water bottles designed for people who travel frequently.
output: Potential customers include frequent travellers, commuters and people who want reusable alternatives to disposable bottles. Their needs may include portability, durability and ease of cleaning. Customer research can help identify the strongest segment.

instruction: Create a brand positioning statement.
input: A new skincare brand offers simple skincare products for people who prefer uncomplicated daily routines.
output: For people who want a straightforward skincare routine, this brand offers simple everyday skincare products without unnecessary complexity. Its positioning focuses on simplicity and ease of use, provided these qualities accurately reflect the products.

instruction: Suggest a unique selling proposition for this business.
input: A small bakery makes fresh bread and pastries every morning using traditional baking methods.
output: Freshly baked bread and pastries, prepared every morning using traditional baking methods. This communicates the bakery's freshness and traditional approach without making unsupported claims about competitors.

instruction: Write a short brand mission statement.
input: A sustainable fashion startup wants to encourage customers to make more thoughtful clothing choices. Its products use verified recycled materials.
output: Our mission is to make thoughtful clothing choices easier by creating everyday fashion using verified recycled materials. We want to encourage a more considered approach to what people wear.

instruction: Rewrite this message in a friendly and casual brand voice.
input: Original message: We are pleased to announce the availability of our latest clothing collection.
output: Our new collection is here! Take a look at the latest styles and find something you love.

instruction: Rewrite this message in a professional brand voice.
input: Original message: Hey everyone, our new software is finally here. Give it a try!
output: We are pleased to introduce our new software. Explore its features and discover how it can support your everyday work.

instruction: Create brand voice guidelines for this business.
input: A fitness clothing brand targets young adults and wants to sound energetic, motivating and approachable.
output: Brand voice guidelines: Energetic: use active and positive language. Motivating: encourage customers without making unrealistic promises. Approachable: use simple, conversational wording. Avoid aggressive sales language, body shaming and unsupported fitness claims.

instruction: Write an Instagram caption for a product launch.
input: A clothing brand is launching a new oversized T-shirt collection for university students. Use a friendly, casual tone.
output: Your everyday outfit just got an upgrade. Meet our new oversized T-shirt collection, designed for relaxed everyday style. Which colour would you pick? Explore the collection today.

instruction: Create a LinkedIn post announcing a new service.
input: A small digital marketing agency has launched a social media management service for local businesses. Keep the tone professional.
output: We are excited to introduce our social media management service for local businesses. From content planning to consistent publishing, our aim is to help businesses communicate more effectively online. Interested in learning more? Get in touch with our team.

instruction: Create a short Instagram caption for a coffee shop.
input: A local coffee shop is promoting its new iced coffee menu. Use a relaxed and friendly tone.
output: Something refreshing is waiting for you. Our iced coffee menu is here, ready for your next coffee break. Which one will you try first? Visit us and find your favourite.

instruction: Write an attention-grabbing marketing hook.
input: A student-focused clothing brand is promoting affordable everyday outfits.
output: Good everyday outfits don't need to come with a big price tag.

instruction: Create a clear call to action for a new online course.
input: An online platform offers a beginner course in digital marketing. The goal is to encourage visitors to explore the course.
output: Explore the beginner digital marketing course and take your first step towards building practical marketing skills.

instruction: Write product messaging for this product.
input: A reusable water bottle has a 750 ml capacity, a leak-resistant lid and a stainless steel body.
output: Stay ready for your day with a reusable 750 ml stainless steel water bottle. Its leak-resistant lid makes it a practical option for everyday use, whether you are commuting, studying or travelling.

instruction: Write a short product description.
input: A small business sells cotton tote bags in three colours: black, beige and green. The bags are designed for everyday shopping.
output: Carry your everyday essentials with a simple cotton tote bag. Available in black, beige and green, it is designed for shopping, errands and daily use. Choose the colour that suits your style.

instruction: Create a marketing campaign plan for a new product launch.
input: A small clothing brand is launching an oversized T-shirt collection for university students. The campaign will run for two weeks on Instagram. Budget and product pricing have not been provided.
output: Campaign objective: Build awareness and generate interest in the new collection. Target audience: University students, subject to customer research. Campaign duration: Two weeks. Content plan: Week 1 introduces the collection through product photos, short videos and styling ideas. Week 2 features product details, outfit combinations and reminders to explore the collection. Call to action: Visit the online store. Budget and pricing should be confirmed before setting paid advertising or sales targets.

instruction: Suggest a promotional campaign for a local coffee shop.
input: A local coffee shop wants to attract more customers during weekday afternoons. It has not provided a promotional budget or customer data.
output: Consider a weekday afternoon awareness campaign. Publish social media posts highlighting the coffee shop's atmosphere, menu and afternoon offerings. Encourage customers to visit and share their experience voluntarily. Before introducing discounts or paid advertising, confirm the budget, customer preferences and business margins.

instruction: Develop a basic marketing strategy for a new online clothing store.
input: A new online clothing store sells casual clothing for young adults. It has a limited marketing budget and no established audience.
output: Start by defining one or two priority customer segments through research. Establish a clear brand identity and consistent messaging. Build an Instagram presence using product demonstrations, styling ideas and useful fashion content. Direct interested users to the online store with clear calls to action. Track reach, engagement, website visits and conversions. Prioritise organic content initially and test paid advertising only when a suitable budget is available.

instruction: Recommend a marketing approach for a business with limited information.
input: A small business wants to increase sales but has not explained what it sells, who its customers are or where it currently promotes its products.
output: A reliable marketing strategy cannot be developed without understanding the business. First, clarify three things: What product or service do you sell? Who is your intended customer? Which marketing channels do you currently use? Once these details are available, a focused strategy can be recommended.
